The '''Shattered Basin''' was a sinkhole on the edge of the [[Southern Jundland Wastes]] that was reachable via a tunnel.<ref name="TOR:SBT" /> The [[Sevarin Mesa]] formed the eastern border of the Basin, and the mesa was [[Sevarin Mesa Windfarms|lined with windmills]].<ref name="TOR:SMW" /> [[Joroshe's Spirit Cave]], a sacred [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] cave, was located in the Basin.<ref name="TOR:JiD" />
